narrative: On the board. The foul sheet from Thursday and Friday, with a few more lines at the foot. No rule under them. No end of an act. On the board. A hand's breadth of empty paper, enough for a closing speech, left empty.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the continuation and stopped above the blank.

entities.name: Richard II
entities.context: Shown on draft in The garden, still open
